questions.q_en: Your truncation series was ranked on HADDOCK score. Take me inside that number: what is it a sum of, and what does it leave out that matters for a flexible peptide?
questions.q_zh: 你們的截短系列是用 HADDOCK score 排序的。請帶我看看這個數字裡面有什麼：它是哪些項加起來的？對一個柔軟的肽來說，它漏掉了什麼？
questions.a_en: It is a weighted sum of four terms, van der Waals, electrostatics, desolvation and the restraint energy, in arbitrary units. No entropy term, and it is not a free energy. Our audit on 30 July found 93 percent of its variance across BoPEP4 variants is explained by length and net charge alone, and its correlation with Pearce's measured activities is rho about plus 0.05. Worse, our best-scoring and most convergent cluster is the one with the C-terminal anchor 13 angstrom out of place, and its whole advantage sat in the electrostatic term. So we compare per unit of interface, never raw.
questions.a_zh: 它是四個項的加權和：van der Waals、靜電、去溶劑化，還有 restraint 能量，單位是任意單位。沒有熵的項，也不是自由能。我們 7 月 30 日的審查發現，BoPEP4 各變異體之間的分數變異有 93% 只用長度和淨電荷就能解釋，而它跟 Pearce 量測活性的相關係數 rho 大約只有 +0.05。更糟的是，我們分數最好、收斂最好的那個 cluster，正是 C 端錨點偏離 13 Å 的那一個，而它的優勢全部來自靜電項。所以我們一律換算成每單位界面來比，不看原始分數。
questions.trap_en: Defending a score difference between two rungs. A longer chain buries more surface and scores better for that reason alone.
questions.trap_zh: 替兩個階梯之間的分數差辯護。鏈越長埋藏面積越大，光是這一點就讓分數變好。
questions.basis: judge pattern: make them define the metric their own figure is drawn on

questions.q_en: Your methodology page says nine two-body docking runs on BoPEP4 produced nothing usable. What went wrong, and what did you do instead?
questions.q_zh: 你們的 methodology 頁寫，BoPEP4 的九次雙體 docking 沒有一個可用。問題出在哪裡？後來你們改做什麼？
questions.a_en: Measured against the crystal, no cluster representative came within 4 angstrom of the native backbone and the best reached 4.44. The run with the tightest convergence put the conserved C-terminal anchor 13 angstrom out of position. Two faults explain it. Each of the nine runs started from a different peptide conformation, so the series was never a controlled comparison. And every run built the termini neutral, which deletes the C-terminal carboxylate that makes the 2.40 angstrom anchor contact, so the thing the peptide binds with was not in the model. We moved to threading on the crystal backbone and kept HADDOCK for refinement only.
questions.a_zh: 跟晶體比對後，沒有任何一個 cluster 代表結構落在原生主鏈 4 Å 以內，最好的是 4.44 Å。而收斂最緊的那一次，把保守的 C 端錨點放偏了 13 Å。兩個錯誤造成這件事：九次 run 各自從不同的肽構形出發，所以這個系列從來不是受控比較；而且每一次都把兩端建成中性，這會刪掉形成 2.40 Å 錨點接觸的 C 端羧基，也就是肽真正用來結合的那個基團根本不在模型裡。後來我們改成在晶體主鏈上 threading，HADDOCK 只留著做精修。
questions.trap_en: Presenting the docking as a successful prediction. It did not reproduce the crystal, and the page says so.
questions.trap_zh: 把 docking 說成成功的預測。它沒有重現晶體，頁面上也這樣寫。
questions.basis: the negative result the team published about its own main tool

questions.q_en: Your cross-run table reports backbone RMSD. What is that actually tracking, and why do you refuse to rank constructs on it?
questions.q_zh: 你們的跨 run 表格有報 backbone RMSD。它實際上在追蹤什麼？為什麼你們不用它來替構築排名？
questions.a_en: Backbone RMSD is how far the peptide has moved from where it started, not how well the receptor is holding it. Across our eight peptide-bearing runs it tracks the Asn23 to Arg487 salt bridge at Spearman plus 0.29, and the four-contact clamp at plus 0.03, the wrong way; contact count does better at plus 0.55. The proof is in our own table. Ranked on RMSD, the 6xHis construct comes first in the whole set, and that is the one construct with no salt bridge left to measure. RMSF did answer its own question: Gly1 fluctuates 3.51 angstrom and everything from Glu12 on stays under one.
questions.a_zh: Backbone RMSD 量的是肽離起點移動了多遠，不是受體抓得有多穩。在我們八個帶肽的 run 裡，它跟 Asn23 對 Arg487 的鹽橋相關是 Spearman +0.29，跟四接觸的 clamp 是 +0.03，而且方向是反的；接觸數好一些，是 +0.55。證據就在我們自己的表上：照 RMSD 排，6xHis 構築是全套第一名，而那正是唯一一個已經沒有鹽橋可以量的構築。RMSF 倒是回答了它自己能回答的問題：Gly1 擺動 3.51 Å，從 Glu12 往後都在 1 Å 以內。
questions.trap_en: Treating a low RMSD as a stable complex. On our set the most stable-looking run is the broken construct.
questions.trap_zh: 把低 RMSD 當成複合體穩定。在我們這一套裡，看起來最穩的那個 run 就是壞掉的構築。
questions.basis: the metric a judge will see on the figure and read as stability

questions.q_en: Thirty nanoseconds, one seed per system. Put a number on the gap between that and the process you care about, and tell me what the single seed costs you.
questions.q_zh: 每個系統 30 奈秒、只有一個隨機種子。請給我一個數量級，說明這跟你們真正在意的過程差多少？只有一個種子又讓你們失去什麼？
kw_zh: 一個種子一條鬆弛路徑
questions.a_en: Thirty nanoseconds is three to six orders of magnitude short of a dissociation event, so nothing on that page is an affinity, an off rate or a free energy. The 15-23 run was meant to give us a leaving time and could not have, whatever it did. Each system has one seed after the same equilibration schedule, so a difference between two runs may only be two relaxation paths. And pH 5.5 means we held three histidines protonated for the whole thirty nanoseconds from model pKa values, not constant-pH MD. The apo run is the guard rail: any receptor-side difference under about half an angstrom sits inside its floor.
questions.a_zh: 30 奈秒比一次解離事件短了三到六個數量級，所以那一頁上沒有任何東西是親和力、解離速率或自由能。15-23 那個 run 本來是要給我們一個離開時間，但不管它跑出什麼都給不了。每個系統在同一套平衡流程之後只有一個種子，所以兩個 run 之間的差異可能只是兩條鬆弛路徑。而所謂 pH 5.5，其實是我們依模型 pKa 把三個 histidine 固定成質子化狀態整整 30 奈秒，不是 constant-pH MD。apo 那個 run 是護欄：受體端小於大約半個 Å 的差異，都落在它的底線裡面。
questions.trap_en: Calling thirty nanoseconds a stability measurement, or reading a difference between two single-seed runs as a result.
questions.trap_zh: 把 30 奈秒說成穩定性的量測，或把兩個單種子 run 之間的差異當成結果。
questions.basis: judge pattern: how long, how many, and what does that buy

questions.q_en: You report AlphaFold confidence for these complexes. What did the 0.73 against 0.74 result tell you, and what did you change because of it?
questions.q_zh: 你們有報這些複合體的 AlphaFold 信心值。0.73 對 0.74 那個結果告訴你們什麼？你們因此改了什麼？
questions.a_en: Our 30 July audit found AlphaFold 3 returned ipTM 0.73 for a peptide published as more than four thousandfold inactive, against 0.74 for BoPEP4. Confidence is not activity, so after that we used it only as a structural confidence estimate and never to rank a design. Two things changed. We score each chain pair separately with pDockQ2, because one averaged number lets a confident pair hide a failed one. And we gate before the unknown: per-residue confidence across the groove, a Ramachandran and clash check, and US-align onto 5GR8 so the groove has to superpose. Five models from one seed are the predictor's uncertainty about one answer, not an ensemble.
questions.a_zh: 我們 7 月 30 日的審查發現，AlphaFold 3 給一個文獻上活性差四千倍以上的肽 ipTM 0.73，而 BoPEP4 是 0.74。信心值不是活性，所以之後我們只把它當結構信心的估計，絕不用它替設計排名。有兩件事因此改了：我們用 pDockQ2 對每一組鏈分開計分，因為單一平均值會讓一組有信心的界面蓋住另一組失敗的；還有我們在跑未知目標前先設門檻——溝槽上的逐殘基信心、Ramachandran 與碰撞檢查，以及用 US-align 疊到 5GR8，溝槽必須疊得起來。同一個種子的五個模型只是預測器對一個答案的不確定度，不是構形集合。
questions.trap_en: Quoting a confidence value as evidence the peptide binds. Published benchmarks also put receptor-peptide-co-receptor assemblies among the harder cases.
questions.trap_zh: 拿信心值當作肽會結合的證據。文獻的 benchmark 也把受體—肽—共受體這類組裝列為較難的案例。
questions.basis: confidence scores read as activity is the commonest in-silico overclaim

questions.q_en: You cut eight residues off the front for the 9-23 candidate. Tell me what each part of that segment was doing, and what your own MD says about cutting at nine.
questions.q_zh: 為了 9-23 這個候選，你們把前面八個殘基切掉。請說明那一段裡各個部分原本在做什麼，還有你們自己的 MD 對「切在 9」有什麼說法？
questions.a_en: Residues one to six make no receptor contact and the hydrophobic GILIG block is a secretion liability, so cutting them costs nothing we can measure. Lysine 7 is different: it is the first belt residue, and K7A was the only alanine mutant that moved the peptide, by 1.62 angstrom. Cutting at nine removes that anchor while keeping the nine to fourteen segment it was holding, and clamp integrity drops to 77 percent against 98.5 for 7-23 and 99.9 for 15-23. The ladder is not monotonic; it dips at 9-23. Shorter is not worse, losing an anchor without its segment is. All three cuts are in the panel, so the bench can settle it.
questions.a_zh: 殘基 1 到 6 不跟受體接觸，而疏水的 GILIG 區塊對分泌是個負擔，所以切掉它們沒有我們量得出來的代價。Lysine 7 不一樣：它是帶狀結構的第一個殘基，而 K7A 是唯一一個會讓肽移動的 alanine 突變，移了 1.62 Å。切在 9 等於把那個錨點拿掉，卻留著它原本在固定的 9 到 14 這一段，於是 clamp 完整度掉到 77%，7-23 是 98.5%，15-23 是 99.9%。這個階梯不是單調的，它在 9-23 凹下去。所以不是越短越差，是失去錨點卻留著它錨住的那一段比較差。三個切點都在 panel 裡，所以這件事實驗桌可以定。
questions.trap_en: Saying 1-8 does nothing. Lys7 and Lys8 are not the same residue, and our own pages disagree about whether 7-23 was ordered.
questions.trap_zh: 說 1 到 8 什麼都沒做。Lys7 跟 Lys8 不一樣，而我們自己的頁面對 7-23 有沒有訂也說法不一。
questions.basis: the production molecule's boundary is the one design choice the bench inherits

questions.q_en: Suppose I grant you the structural work. Design me the bench experiment that decides whether that short motif is sufficient, and name what makes it interpretable.
questions.q_zh: 假設我接受你們的結構工作。請設計一個實驗桌上的實驗，決定那個短 motif 到底夠不夠，並說出什麼能讓它被解讀。
kw_en: three cuts against two dead controls
kw_zh: 三個切點對兩個死對照
questions.a_en: The panel is already built for it: three truncations, 7-23, 9-23 and 15-23, on one backbone, beside S15A and G17A, which published work puts about a hundredfold and more than four thousandfold down. The plan on our Engineering page is to grow verified transformants in the reactor under dark and red or green light, take lumen lysate, lumen medium and shell medium at each time point, and run anti-His blots, then compare each variant against its constitutive version. Two things make it readable. Quantify before activity, because activity per milligram is the number that means something. And carry an untransformed host control, because ours has already read in the same range as the constructs once.
questions.a_zh: 這個 panel 本來就是為它建的：同一個骨架上三個截短版 7-23、9-23、15-23，旁邊放 S15A 和 G17A，文獻把它們放在大約差一百倍和四千倍以上。我們 Engineering 頁上的計畫是：把定序確認的轉型株放進反應器，在暗處、紅光和綠光下培養，每個時間點取管腔細胞裂解液、管腔培養液和殼側培養液，跑 anti-His 墨點，再把每個變異體跟它的組成型版本比。有兩件事讓它能讀：先定量再測活性，因為有意義的數字是每毫克的活性；還要帶未轉型的宿主對照，因為我們的宿主對照已經有一次讀到跟構築同一個範圍。
questions.trap_en: Describing a blot without a quantified denominator. Protein per millilitre of supernatant is not activity per milligram of enzyme.
questions.trap_zh: 描述一個沒有定量分母的墨點。每毫升上清液的蛋白量不等於每毫克酵素的活性。
questions.basis: judge pattern: turn an in-silico claim into a falsifiable experiment

questions.q_en: Six histidines on a peptide this short. Beyond the anchor contact you have told me about, what is that tag doing?
questions.q_zh: 在這麼短的肽上掛六個 histidine。除了你們已經說過的錨點接觸之外，這個標籤還做了什麼？
kw_zh: 沒有 OXT 就沒有鍵
串聯分析也得出同一結論
questions.a_en: On the registered truncation fusion the payload is nine residues and the tag is six, so most of what we secrete is tag. Position matters more than that. Asn23 is held by five contacts, the shortest being its OXT to Arg487 at 2.40 angstrom. On the tagged construct there is no OXT at all: Asn23 became internal and its carboxylate was spent forming the bond to His24, which is why 2.4 percent occupancy there is not a weak salt bridge, it is no salt bridge. Our tandem-repeat analysis reached the same conclusion from chain chemistry alone. The June and July cassettes append the tag directly after the peptide; constructs ordered after 16 August put it at the front.
questions.a_zh: 在已登錄的截短融合裡，酬載是九個殘基、標籤是六個，所以我們分泌出去的東西大部分是標籤。但位置比這個更重要。Asn23 是靠五個接觸固定的，最短的是它的 OXT 對 Arg487 的 2.40 Å。而在帶標籤的構築上根本沒有 OXT：Asn23 變成內部殘基，它的羧基被用去跟 His24 形成鍵，所以那裡 2.4% 的占有率不是「弱鹽橋」，是沒有鹽橋。我們的串聯重複分析只用鏈端化學也得到同一個結論。6、7 月的卡匣是把標籤直接接在肽後面；8 月 16 日之後訂的構築改放在前面。
questions.trap_en: Saying every construct is N-terminal. Engineering records C-terminal in the design text and N-terminal in the construct table, with primers for both.
questions.trap_zh: 說所有構築都是 N 端。Engineering 的設計文字寫 C 端、構築表寫 N 端，而且兩個方向的 primer 都有。
questions.basis: the project's own caught-in-time mistake, pushed one step further

questions.q_en: Of everything on your protein design pages, what has an experimental counterpart?
questions.q_zh: 你們蛋白質設計那幾頁上的東西，有哪些有對應的實驗？
kw_en: ACC deaminase yes, the other two no
kw_zh: ACC deaminase 有，另兩個沒有
questions.a_en: One of the three, and I should be precise about which. ACC deaminase has bench work: anti-His ELISA puts it between 3.4 and 6.5 micrograms per millilitre through both October reactor runs, the 2 August fractionation blot found it in the supernatant and not the pellets, and in one salt experiment treated plants held more chlorophyll than their controls. BoPEP4 and LEA14 have none. No binding assay, no thermal shift, and their effects on plants remain untested, so the activity assay that would rank the truncations against our two dead controls is not among our results. The reporter we expected to read by eye, AmilCP, never coloured the medium at all.
questions.a_zh: 三個裡面只有一個，而我應該講清楚是哪一個。ACC deaminase 有實驗：anti-His ELISA 在十月兩次反應器實驗中都把它放在每毫升 3.4 到 6.5 微克，8 月 2 日的分層墨點在上清液裡找到它、沉澱裡沒有，而在一次鹽逆境實驗中處理過的植株葉綠素比對照高。BoPEP4 和 LEA14 都沒有：沒有結合實驗、沒有熱位移，對植物的效果也還沒測，所以能把截短版和兩個死對照排序的活性實驗不在我們的結果裡。而我們本來打算用肉眼判讀的 AmilCP 報告子，培養液從來沒有出現顏色。
questions.trap_en: Saying nothing has been tested. ACC deaminase now has a quantified ELISA and a plant result, and claiming otherwise undersells real work.
questions.trap_zh: 說什麼都還沒測。ACC deaminase 現在有定量的 ELISA 和植物結果，講得太低反而低估了真正做過的工作。
questions.basis: team's own gap: two of three designed protectants have no bench counterpart

questions.q_en: AlphaFold and HADDOCK are free, and every team in your village can run them. What in this work is yours?
questions.q_zh: AlphaFold 和 HADDOCK 都是免費的，你們 village 裡每一隊都跑得動。那這份工作裡，哪一部分是你們自己的？
kw_en: the mutation that did not exist
kw_zh: 拒絕 dock 那個酵素
questions.a_en: Not the tools. Three things. We ran the controls that embarrass the tools: the four-thousandfold-dead peptide scored 0.73 against wild type's 0.74, and the score audit voided every claim resting on a score difference. We caught a sequence error with an alignment: a substitution our design document called Y156C does not exist in our protein, it is F156C, and three docking runs had already gone out against the wrong background. And we declined to dock ACC deaminase at all, because its cofactor and substrate are covalently attached before chemistry starts, so a docking number would have meant nothing. We followed the field rather than our own familiarity.
questions.a_zh: 不是工具，是三件事。第一，我們跑了會讓工具難堪的對照：那個活性差四千倍的肽拿到 0.73，野生型是 0.74；而分數審查作廢了所有建立在分數差上的主張。第二，我們用序列比對抓到一個錯誤：設計文件一直叫 Y156C 的突變在我們的蛋白裡根本不存在，它是 F156C，而那時已經有三次 docking 用錯的背景送出去了。第三，我們決定完全不對 ACC deaminase 做 docking，因為它的輔因子和受質在化學反應開始前就已經共價接上，docking 的數字不會有意義。我們選擇跟著這個領域的做法，而不是跟著自己熟悉的工具。
questions.trap_en: Claiming the pipeline is novel. The pipeline is standard; the controls, the caught error and the tool we refused to use are what a team adds now.
questions.trap_zh: 說這個流程很新。流程是標準的；現在一支隊伍能加上的，是對照、抓到的錯誤，以及我們拒絕使用的那個工具。
questions.basis: positioning: everyone runs the same tools, so what counts is the control
